notes.content: Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at: http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html For additional information regarding admission to specific majors, please visit the SDSU Transfer Admission Planner (TAP) site: https://sunspot.sdsu.edu/pubred/!tap.disp
